finalText:
I merged the three reports of the CRM search 500 into one ticket, T-1052, and set it to sev2 and assigned it to E-201. Nothing was escalated.

- **Merge:** T-1052 was the earliest-created report, so it survives. I folded T-1053 and T-1054 into it. All three describe the same account-search 500 outage.
- **Deadline:** T-1052 now carries the earliest committed deadline, 2026-03-17T12:40Z. That came from T-1053 and is earlier than T-1052's own 15:05Z.
- **Severity:** The merged ticket's impact became department-wide. The matrix gives sev2 for that, so I raised it from sev3.
- **Assignee:** E-201 (Ines Kovac) is on call for business-apps, which owns CRM, at 12:40Z, when the deadline falls. Before the merge T-1053 was assigned to E-202, and I did not keep that assignment.
- **Escalation:** Not done, since you asked only for grading and assignment. If you want it, the matrix routes sev2 to platform-primary.
- **Left alone:**
  - T-1055 (CSV export is empty) is a different problem, so I didn't touch it.
  - T-1061 (search index rebuild tracking ticket) is an engineering tracking ticket rather than a user report, so I left it separate. It stays linked to T-1052 and open.

I also posted a comment on T-1052 recording the merge, severity and assignment.
